'''Cactobud''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Cactobloom]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Cactobud loves hugs, but hardly gets any from other Tatari. Why does everyone run away so fast?"

Cactobud is a purple rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
A small, green cactus creature with round, white eyes and a pink flower. It has four stubby little legs and a triangular mouth.

Cactobud's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form is bright cyan instead of green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Cactobud's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Cactobloom]] you need to complete the following task:
* Bring Cactobud to [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]] 3 times. Hug a Zobo today!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "In a volleyball game, Cactobud can sub in for the ball. It makes the game more... fun. And pointy. Mostly Pointy."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Cactobuds are covered in spines but have an expression so cute that makes you want to touch them regardless. When Tatari reach out but withdraw in tears, Cactobuds can feel hurt, too."
